title: HELLDIVERS™ 2

quotes.text: How about a nice cup of Liber-tea?
There is but one assured path to peace... and that path is war.
I only regret that I have but one ship's worth of lives to give to our cause.
Helldivers 2 runs on Autodesk's Stingray engine, discontinued by Autodesk back in 2018.
After the game sold 12 million copies, Arrowhead noted there were now more Helldivers than Swedes.
Every squad loses at least one Helldiver to a poorly aimed orbital strike. Usually more than one.
Nobody reads the stratagem input before throwing it. Everyone learns the 380mm barrage the hard way.

notes: appid 553850 confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game, name='HELLDIVERS™ 2', developer Arrowhead Game Studios). Only one SKU on Steam; the storefront description shown by appdetails is for the Digital Deluxe Edition bundle, but the appid/title/developer are for the base game itself, so no SKU ambiguity. Helldiver/Democracy Officer lines verified verbatim against Wikiquote's Helldivers 2 page, which compiles in-game barks and propaganda lines by category (Helldiver dialogue, Democracy Officer). The Stingray-engine and 12-million-copies/Sweden facts are both independently corroborated (PC Gamer, GameDeveloper.com, Sony Q1 2024 earnings commentary from Arrowhead's then-CEO Johan Pilestedt).
